rounds.text: Conceded: [E6]. Despite high headline profitability and returns on capital, the business suffers from a severe disconnect between reported earnings and actual cash generation, as cash conversion sits at just 0.31x for Mar 2026 [E17]. Operating cash flow accounts for a mere 41% of operating profit, directly pointing to mounting receivables or accruals that leave profits far ahead of real cash [E17, E20]. This cash lag is further compounded by a steep deterioration in working capital efficiency, with working capital days swelling significantly from 78.2 days to 139 days [E37]. Furthermore, foreign institutional investors have trimmed their holdings by 1.15 percentage points to 14.02% as of Jun 2026, indicating some institutional caution [E26]. Finally, despite reporting profits, the company offers a dividend yield of 0.00% and provides no cash return to shareholders [E4, E36].
